title: Apple Patches CoreGraphics Flaw Possibly Exploited in Targeted Attacks
summary: Apple has released security updates to address a vulnerability in older versions of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS that it said may have been exploited in targeted attacks.
card_summary: Apple has released security updates to address a vulnerability in older versions of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS that it said may have been exploited in targeted attacks.
email_summary: Apple has released security updates to address a vulnerability in older versions of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS that it said may have been exploited in targeted attacks. Tracked as CVE-2026-86950. Severity is rated critical.

title: Hackers Use NeedyMantis to Maintain Long-Term Access in Breached Networks
summary: Hackers have used a malware family called NeedyMantis to maintain long-term access to networks they had already breached, Microsoft said in a technical analysis.
card_summary: Hackers have used a malware family called NeedyMantis to maintain long-term access to networks they had already breached, Microsoft said in a technical analysis.

sections.context: This fits the broader data-exposure trend where follow-on abuse of leaked information is common.

email_summary: Hackers have used a malware family called NeedyMantis to maintain long-term access to networks they had already breached, Microsoft said in a technical analysis. The malware has been seen in a small number of targeted intrusions at telecommunications organizations, universities, medical nonprofits, intergovernmental organizations, and government contractors.
